title: the deity stat lines
audit_comment: THE DEITY STAT LINES - the R406 messy reads pin at last (Curtiss's Appendix S pick). The 23 blocks ride the 1eonline.info compilation pages (the repo-trusted source the R189 duty reads), row-verified against the R406 pins (armor class, hit points, magic resistance, attack halves, damage spans - every row cross-matched; where the compilation fills a hole the print pins stand: Hanali's 99, Brandobaris's unrecorded damage, Shargaas's attack hole). THE GRID: 23 x 12 plus 23 x 13 - the five class/level lines (every Nil reads zero, the halfling titles read as levels, the "in each" fills both columns, all five orc FIGHTER lines read as monsters, the print's own Dumathoin typo rides verbatim), the MOVE rates (base + the parenthetical second rate; Aerdrie's flight-only phrase carries no number), the seven ability lines (signed - Yurtrus -4/-25; the 18/00 and 18/01 slash prints split to the pct column; the CH/Com parentheticals with Hanali's special sentinel), and the DAMAGE/ATTACK bonus (the see-below sentinel for Labelas and Yurtrus). THE CROSS-CHECK: the damage bonus equals the S parenthetical damage bonus on all 15 rows that print both - and the three prints that refuse the pattern pin as they stand (Arvoreen +8 with no S parenthetical, Bahgtru +15 against the S +14, Solonor's S +9 with no damage bonus). Honest boundaries: the parenthetical reads and the special/see-text levels ride contract-side (the prose is the prose), the Yurtrus destructive-spells-only qualifier and Cyrrollalee's by-weapon-type damage ride contract-side, and the stat-block prose alone stays open

prev_record: - R782 LANDED 2026-10-23: commit
THE OWED PINS AND THE DEITY SITE - four feeds
in one round (Curtiss's all-four pick), header
rules/owedpins.h, prefix owd (free at 1501749).
FIFTEEN FILE PATCHES over five files: (1) the
lance printed cells the R780 boundary owed -
the lengths 10/12/14 feet and the 1-foot
space-required cell pin as data (the R780
engine sense stands: no caller reads a
length); (2) the spear 6..8 spread ends its
contract-side stay - weaponspeed.h gains
spearSpeedFactorByLengthFt (5 feet and under
reads 6, 13 and over reads 8, the middle keeps
the R158 default 7); (3) the deity layer site
lands - the R405 no-site contract is STRUCK:
ai::toDeityActor copies every Appendix S stat
block onto a monster-side Actor (the printed
hp and AC whole via monsterAcOverride/-100
sentinel, the halves halved, the damage span
on the dice plus the monsterDamagePlus floor),
nhdStatBlocksOpen flips false, and a live
SITE BLOCK in regtest walks all 23 blocks
through the bridge - its printf carries NO
census marker ("R782 deity bridge site", not
"...audit...") so the census counts the pin
audit alone (a bad still fails the battery
by the return); (4) the DMG p.66 closing
bar - a mounted front in round one is a
closing charge, exempt from the case-1 tie
order and the case-2 extra window
(factorApplies; the monster side never
lance-charges, the R779 boundary stands).
CRITICAL WIRING the Python mirror cannot
see: the R405 layer-contract assertions in
the regtest audit flipped WITH the deities.h
flips (fail-on-wrong stands - flipping the
header alone would have turned the battery
RED), regtest gained the ai/actor.h include
(the site block calls the bridge; the battery
build links actor.cpp), actor.h gained the
uaappends.h include (the bridge decl), and
the R406 hole cells ride their sentinels
verbatim: the attack holes (Hanali 0,
Shargaas -1) floor to one routine on the
bridge with the site check mirroring the
floor (wantAtk), the AC hole 99 and
Cyrrollalee's unrecorded damage span (-1)
round-trip whole. ONE preflight, GREEN first
pass (the R781 lesson held: include wiring
and sentinel floors traced before publish).
NEXT - R783: the next target awaits
Curtiss's call.

banner.title: THE DEITY STAT LINES - the R406 messy reads pin: the class/level lines, the MOVE rates, the seven ability lines, the damage bonuses
banner.provenance: R406 pinned the scan-clean stat-line numerics and left the messy reads open: the six class/level lines, the MOVE values, the S/I/W/D/C/CH/CM stat lines, the prose. R783 pins everything but the prose. The 23 blocks ride the 1eonline.info compilation (the repo-trusted source), row-verified against the R406 pins - armor class, hit points, magic resistance, attack halves, damage spans all cross-match, and where the compilation fills a hole the print pins stand. The grid is 23 x 12 plus 23 x 13: the class/level lines pin verbatim (every Nil reads zero; the halfling titles read as levels - Patriarch C8, Ranger Lord R12, Master Thief T10, Master of Dragons M8; the "in each" fills both columns; all five orc FIGHTER lines read as monsters; Dumathoin's "12 level thief" typo rides the pin, not the fix). The MOVE rates pin base plus parenthetical second (Aerdrie prints the flight-only phrase with no number). The ability lines pin signed (Yurtrus -4/-25), the slash strengths split to a pct column (18/00, 18/01), and the CH/Com parentheticals pin with Hanali's special sentinel. The DAMAGE/ATTACK bonuses pin with the see-below sentinel (Labelas, Yurtrus), and the cross-column check rides: the bonus equals the S parenthetical damage bonus on all 15 rows that print both, with the three refusing prints pinned as they stand (Arvoreen, Bahgtru, Solonor). Honest boundaries: the parenthetical reads, the special/see-text levels, the destructive-spells-only qualifier, and the by-weapon-type damage ride contract-side; the prose alone stays open
banner.sentinel: Zero new book pages: the stat lines ride the Appendix S pp. 110-120 blocks the R405/R406 pins already seat, and the compilation source rides the R189 speed-verify duty already trusted

bools.comment: All five orc FIGHTER lines read as N-HD monsters (16+, 10, 15, 13, 12) - the kind code 13 row census

bools.name: dvpStrPctCellsPinTheSlash

bools.name: dvpDamageBonusQuirksArePrint

bools.name: dvpParenReadsRideContractSide
bools.comment: The parenthetical numbers pin as data; what they MEAN (the CH/Com reads toward worshippers, the special CH) rides contract-side - the print is the print

bools.name: dvpProseStaysOpen
bools.comment: The stat-block prose stays open - the lines pin, the paragraphs do not
